text: I'm a childminder, I've got a little girl staying overnight with me, she's 4. Her temperature is 38.5. I think there are some spots but she has dark skin so it's hard to tell on her arms. I had a look at her palms and the soles of her feet and pulled down her bottom eyelid, and there are tiny dark red-purple dots there. I pressed a glass on her palm and they didn't fade at all. I might be overthinking it and I don't want to panic her parents for nothing, but I wasn't sure what to make of it.
